name: Can I put the shower next to the bathroom window without causing problems?

mainEntity.name: Can I put the shower next to the bathroom window without causing problems?

acceptedAnswer.text: A window can stay in a redesigned bathroom if its size, sill height, privacy, moisture exposure, and relationship to the shower or tub are addressed. Placing a wet fixture near the window may require careful waterproofing and a moisture-resistant finish strategy. Privacy glass, a suitable covering, or a revised fixture arrangement may be appropriate depending on the opening. Photograph the window, record its dimensions, and note whether it is operable before design begins. Elite Remodeling & Design can incorporate the opening into the layout while coordinating ventilation and finish selections.
acceptedAnswer.description: Often, but the window’s sill, frame, operation, privacy, and exposure to water must be reviewed. The design needs appropriate waterproofing and moisture-resistant detailing around the opening. Measure and photograph the window before planning the shower, and compare placing the wet area there with keeping the window in a dry zone.
